overclaims: TechCrunch's October 28, 2026 report states that Microsoft received $24.1 billion in revenue from OpenAI for the full fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, matching the claimed amount and period [e1].
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, conditions and outcome are fine. The rationale says Microsoft 'received' $24.1B. TechCrunch only says FY2026 revenue from OpenAI 'hit $24.1 billion', and the same article reports $6B of OpenAI receivables still outstanding at June 30. 'Received' suggests cash collected, which the contract explicitly excludes. Use 'recorded' or 'recognized' instead. The e1 citation excerpt is cut down to '$24.1 billion.', which drops the fiscal year and the metric. Use the full sentence: 'For the full 2026 fiscal year, revenue from OpenAI hit $24.1 billion.'
